title: Time bound for computing length bits
statement: The finite Boolean Turing machine that outputs the binary bits of the input length computes the function $x\mapsto \operatorname{bits}(|x|)$ in time $n\mapsto 5(n+1)$: for every Boolean word $x$, it halts within $5(|x|+1)$ steps with output equal to the binary representation of $|x|$.
